name: What is the typical process for a fix-and-flip renovation project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a fix-and-flip renovation project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: For investor fix-and-flip renovations, our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your project goals and scope. We then develop a comprehensive design and construction plan, often including CAD-supported layouts, that aligns with enhancing functionality, beauty, and value. Our integrated design-build approach ensures a managed process from concept through construction, installation, and final walkthrough, providing a single point of coordination. We handle all aspects, including permit coordination, to streamline the project for efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our fix-and-flip renovation process involves an initial consultation, comprehensive design and construction planning, and an integrated design-build approach from concept to completion, including permit coordination.
